description: This file defines the KpiSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends a base FilterParams class and adds a jobTitleId property along with related getter and setter methods to facilitate filtering KPI search results by job title. It also sets a default sort field for the search.

classes.name: KpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates search filter parameters for KPI searches, including job title filtering and sort field configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field of 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the current job title ID filter value.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter value.
